en: A monochrome view down a wide, straight boulevard lined with ornate late‑19th‑century apartment and civic buildings in a Central or Eastern European style. The façades have heavy stone rustication, arched windows, iron balconies, and corner turrets with decorative domes. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks and a few small carts or carriages appear on the street. Low hills or mountains are faintly visible at the far end of the avenue. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.
